meta.title: GYROSTREAM
meta.description: Shower nozzles with rotating and pulsating function.
meta.keywords: TOTO Hong Kong, TOTO, toilet, Washlet, Japan, bidet, global, culture, faucet, bathtub

items.context:
The bathroom is a place where health and well-being take centre stage, with temperature a key factor in achieving inner harmony.

GYROSTREAM allows you to relax just as easily in the shower as in the bathtub. That's because with GYROSTREAM, the water is sprayed through rotating nozzles in a precise, pulsating stream and is thus spread more evenly over a wider area. This results in a vortex that continuously rinses the entire body with warm water and, just like in a bathtub, keeps it warm.

The powerful water vortices also provide a massaging effect for a refreshing, reinvigorating shower.
